transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded chart raster (6160x2832 px). Boundaries printed on the right axis and confirmed by chart lines (17.64 px/cm, axis top 139 = printed snowpit depth). Hardness from bar left edges against the grid (260 px/class): 2008=F, 1748=4F, 1488=1F, 1228=P, 1316=P-. Three 8-px pure-red bands sit directly below the 110, 101 and 73 cm boundary lines, each spanning the bar width of the layer beneath, so they are assigned to those layers. Temperature polyline without markers; break points by segment intersection (+-0.3 cm) with x-mapping x = 2115.5 + 46.80*T(C) calibrated on 45 Avanet charts (printed air temperature vs dashed air-temperature segment); readings fall on 0.5 C steps (+-0.1 C); surface value extrapolated to the frame (-18.0). Water content column empty for every row.
